title: Russell M. Nelson
callings: Presidents of the Quorum of the Twelve
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Dantzel White, 1945, Salt Lake Temple; ten children
Medical Doctor with specialty as Cardiac Surgeon
Counselor in Bishopric, High Councilor, Stake President, Regional Representative
Sustained to Twelve and ordained an Apostle 1984
President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, 2015 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
